summary: Frontend-only retest of the new 'Prova con un esempio' (data-testid='capo-fill-example') button in PianoProduzioneAI (Laboratorio). Logged in as admin@mikilab.de, dismissed newsletter popup + Lab tour, navigated via nav-tab-maestro to the Piano generator. ALL requested scenarios PASS: (1) capo-products + capo-generate present; (2) capo-fill-example present inside capo-products-heading, visible, label 'Try an example'; (3) clicking it prefilled 2 product rows (row0 'Pane ai Cereali' qty=20, row1 'Spinach Bread' qty=10), showed the success toast "Example loaded! Now press 'Generate' or change the quantities.", and capo-generate-hint disappeared (count 1 -> 0); clicking capo-generate then started generation (label 'Generate work plan' -> 'Organising the work…', button disabled) and streamed a real plan (1338 chars incl. supplier order, recipes in plan, save-to-archive). (4) REGRESSION OK: capo-products-heading shows badge '1' + 'What are you making today? *' + required-field subtitle; with no data capo-generate is still enabled (disabled=False) and the specific hint "Recipe missing: in 'What are you making today?' choose at least one recipe." is shown. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: fillExample preference sort only guarantees the FIRST match (pane) is on top; second row can be any recipe (here 'Spinach Bread'). Acceptable, but if a deterministic pane+pizza example is desired, pick one recipe per preference keyword.
PianoProduzioneAI.jsx is ~1790 lines — consider splitting (products panel, modules panel, plan renderer) for maintainability.
